Lena Ortiz: Quick thread to lock owners for the CloudMarket co-marketing push. Need blog, marketplace assets, micro-bench narrative, webinar date, and lead routing. Short replies ok. :wave:
Sam Park: I can own the blog and SEO. Propose publish 8 days before webinar. Need partner quote + logo by Oct 20.
Theo Ramos: Webinar pref: Dec 3 at 17:00 UTC. Run-of-show I suggest: 5m host, 20m demo, 10m bench highlights, 15m partner/customer stories, 10m Q&A. Dry run Dec 1.
Anya Singh: Marketplace asset checklist: 1) 1200x628 co-brand hero, 2) logo (png + svg), 3) 200-250 word blurb, 4) 2 screenshots (console + integration flow). Assets due Nov 15.
Lena Ortiz: Bench narrative: three focused metrics only 1) p50 latency @512, 2) throughput on 4-GPU pod, 3) $/1k tokens at recommended config. Keep methods as a single paragraph with link to repo.
Sam Park: Blog outline: partner value prop, 3-step integration, benchmark highlights, CTA to webinar. Draft by Nov 8 for internal review.
Theo Ramos: Promo cadence: announce (T-21), reminder (T-7), last call (T-1), replay (T+1). Also request a 30s partner clip.
Anya Singh: Lead routing plan: marketplace leads -> HubSpot form -> tag cloud_marketplace_dec -> assign regional SDR queues. SLA: contact within 24h. MQL rule: company_size>50 OR title contains "Engineer"/"PM". Please include product_interest checkbox.
Lena Ortiz: UTM scheme: utm_source=cloudmarket, utm_medium=partner, utm_campaign=cloudmarket-dec. Use consistently.
partner-ops-bot: Reminder: "CloudMarket co-launch dry run" scheduled 2024-12-01 15:00 UTC.
